title: ASSET_OUT
description: Output contract of Asset Engine (09_ASSET_ENGINE.md). Consumed by House Engine and Render Engine.

category.description: Only these four values are permitted -- never invent a new category.

safety_status.description: TEXT_DETECTED means overlay text covers >15% of image area -- blocked from use as an AI reference image (House/Video Engine) but may still pass through to Render Engine for direct display.

x-error-codes.ERR_ASSET_NSFW: NSFW/unsafe/copyrighted content detected -- reject that image
x-error-codes.ERR_ASSET_01: Invalid file format -- skip that file, continue with the rest

x-hard-rules: Strict Category Tagging -- only the four enum values, never invent new categories.
Text/overlay >15% of image area blocks AI-reference use, does not block direct Render Engine display.
Resize/compress to <=2MB before uploading to CDN.
Never let an image bearing a competitor watermark/logo through as an AI reference image.
